q: AC⁰ circuits (constant depth, polynomial size, unbounded fan-in AND/OR) cannot compute the parity function (XOR of n bits). The lower bound proof uses:
opts: Switching lemma (random restriction argument) — Håstad's theorem gives exponential lower bounds
exp: Håstad's switching lemma (1986): under random restriction, constant-depth circuits simplify to decision trees. This gives exp(Ω(n^{1/d})) lower bounds for parity in depth-d circuits. Parity ∉ AC⁰ follows with exponential lower bounds on the size of constant-depth circuits.
